description: Source code for PSA cryptography integration with Zephyr RTOS, including key management, CSR generation, hashing, signing, verification, and RNG functions.

methods.name: crp_get_pub_key
methods.description: Retrieves the public key for a given key ID by opening, exporting, and closing the key.

methods.name: crp_imp_key_secp256r1
methods.description: Stores a new persistent secp256r1 key in internal trusted storage.

methods.name: crp_gen_key_secp256r1
methods.description: Generates a new persistent secp256r1 key in internal trusted storage.

methods.name: psa_rng_for_mbedtls
methods.description: Wrapper for PSA RNG to be used with Mbed TLS.

methods.name: crp_generate_csr
methods.description: Generates a device CSR using Mbed TLS and PSA crypto.

methods.name: crp_hash_payload
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 hash of input message.

methods.name: crp_sign_hash
methods.description: Signs a hash with a persistent key.

methods.name: crp_verify_sign
methods.description: Verifies a signature against a hash using a persistent key.

methods.name: crp_dest_key
methods.description: Destroys a persistent key by key ID.

methods.name: crp_test
methods.description: Performs a test sequence: key creation, hashing, signing, verification, and destruction.

methods.name: crp_test_rng
methods.description: Generates and displays 256 bytes of random data.
